title: TagDuel classic renderer 4x4 physical-seat privacy matrix

implementation.behavior: For each initial 2v2 seat rotation, render the public board and private board for each of the four physical seats using four disjoint 20-card decks. Assert classic layout dimensions and that the art provider receives only face-up field/last-grave identities publicly, and only those plus the selected physical viewer's own hand privately.
implementation.validation: Actual renderTag and tagImageLayout with sharp metadata and an injected art provider; no remote art fetch.

limitations: Renderer validation is offline and uses an injected provider returning no art bytes.
No live Discord guild, bot token, production database, or player records are used.
This validates the 2v2 layout/privacy renderer and does not certify a new card.
